name: Cai Rang floating market
kicker: Wholesale boats and cây bẹo poles at dawn
summary: Wholesale fruit boats on the river at dawn: ride among them for an hour, with noodles from a breakfast boat. Sellers hang a sample on a tall cây bẹo pole so buyers can see the goods from afar. Leave Ninh Kiều by 5:00, because the boats pack up by about 8:00. This is the reason to sleep in Can Tho.
getThere: About 30 minutes by boat from Ninh Kiều
heroCaption: Trading boats at Cái Răng, with pineapples on the water

notice.title: A late bus misses the wholesale boats
notice.body: Be on the water by 5:00 or 5:30. A same-morning ride from Ho Chi Minh City arrives after the boats thin out.

body: This is a wholesale market. Sellers hang a sample of their fruit or vegetables on a long pole, the cây bẹo, so buyers can see the goods across the water. Breakfast boats pull alongside with hủ tiếu, bún riêu, and coffee. The market's trading culture went on the national intangible-heritage list in 2016.
Trading runs from about 4:30 to 8:00, and the best hours are 5:00 to 7:00. Plan about 60 minutes among the boats. The ride from Ninh Kiều takes about 30 minutes, so leave the quay at around 5:00.
Flood months from September to November are a good season for the boat trip. By road the market is about 6 km from the centre, in Cái Răng.

figures.caption: Cabbages and a trader on a Cái Răng boat
figures.alt: A trader beside a pile of cabbages on a boat at the Cai Rang floating market

gettingThere: Boats leave from Bến Ninh Kiều and reach the market in about 30 minutes. You can also board at piers closer to the market. By road it is about 6 km from the centre.

legs.heading: From Ninh Kiều
legs.body: Small boat, about 30 minutes. Boat hire runs 300,000 to 700,000 VND a boat, depending on the number of guests.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: Sleep in Can Tho the night before. The city is about 165 km away, and a departure the same morning misses the wholesale boats.

admissionNote: No market ticket is published. Boat hire is 300,000 to 700,000 VND a boat, depending on the number of guests.
